title: AB 494 (2023-2024 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): status as an indefinitely confined voter for purposes of automatically receiving absentee ballots and providing a penalty.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) s. 6.86 (2) (b) (indefinitely confined application)
(quote) Unless the applicant is exempted from providing proof of identification under s. 6.87 (4) (b) 3., or the applicant is a military or overseas elector, the elector shall enclose a copy of his or her proof of identification or any authorized substitute document with his or her application.
(section) s. 6.86 (2) (b) (clerk may not issue ballot without ID copy)
(quote) The clerk shall not issue a ballot to an elector who is required to enclose a copy of proof of identification or an authorized substitute document with his or her application unless the copy is enclosed and the proof is verified by the clerk.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
